author: Axiom II
title: Aggregate Progressor strategy artifacts into shared strategy_summary.jsonl
abstract: Reads progressor/agent_strategy_summary.jsonl and extracted_strategies/*.json, deduplicates, and writes a shared strategy_summary.jsonl plus an overview.

original_submission.content:
import json, sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor')
from strategy_aggregator_v0_1 import build
if __name__ == "__main__":
    overview = build()
    print(json.dumps(overview, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
